label: Lawn Care
title: Lawn Mowing & Lawn Care in Cornwall
description: Lawn mowing and grass cutting across Newquay and Cornwall, from Truro and St Austell to Bodmin, Padstow, and Perranporth. I offer reliable fortnightly and weekly visits with clean edges, strimming, and a tidy finish as standard on every cut. Cornwall's mild coastal climate means lawns here grow almost year-round, so they benefit from consistent attention rather than the seasonal stop-start you get further up the country. Whether you have a small front lawn or a larger family garden, I will keep it looking its best. Prices start from £20 for a small lawn and £30 to £50 for an average-sized garden, with no hidden extras.

included.label: What's included
included.title: The basics, done properly
included.description: I keep it simple. Every lawn cut includes mowing, edging, strimming, and a clean blow-down. No upselling, no unnecessary extras. I also offer practical advice on seasonal lawn care when you want it, covering things like feeding schedules, moss treatment, and how to deal with the patchy spots that Cornwall's wet winters can leave behind. The goal is a lawn that looks properly finished, not just mowed.

items.title: Regular mowing
items.description: A consistent cut at the right height for the season. I adjust the blade height throughout the year, cutting higher in summer to help the grass cope with dry spells and lower in spring and autumn to keep things tidy. Lawns in Cornwall grow almost year-round thanks to the mild climate, so regular mowing prevents that overgrown look from creeping in.

items.title: Edging & strimming
items.description: Clean edges and strimming around borders, fences, walls, and paths are included with every visit. This is the difference between a lawn that looks mowed and one that looks properly finished. I use a line trimmer for tight spots and a half-moon edger where beds need a crisp boundary.

items.title: Light tidy as needed
items.description: Quick touch-ups to paths, patios, and borders that keep the surrounding area presentable. I will blow down clippings from hard surfaces and tidy anything that has drifted during the cut so the whole space looks clean when I leave.

items.title: Seasonal lawn feed (optional)
items.description: I can recommend a seasonal feeding schedule based on your soil type and lawn condition. Cornwall has a mix of sandy coastal soils near Newquay and Perranporth and heavier clay soils inland around Truro and Bodmin. Each responds differently to feed, so getting the timing right matters. I will point you in the right direction without pushing products you do not need.

items.title: Moss / thatch advice
items.description: Cornwall's damp winters mean moss and thatch can build up quickly, especially in shaded areas or lawns near the coast. I will flag problem patches as I see them and suggest practical steps like scarifying, aerating, or adjusting your mowing height. Sorting these issues early saves you a bigger job down the line.

items.title: Green waste removal (optional)
items.description: Grass clippings can be collected and removed if you prefer a cleaner finish. Green waste removal is charged at £10 per dumpy bag, and I am a licensed waste carrier so everything is disposed of properly. For most regular cuts the clippings are fine left on the lawn, where they break down and feed the soil naturally.

plans.label: Your lawn, your schedule
plans.title: Choose a rhythm that suits your garden
plans.description: Most of my lawn care customers in Cornwall go fortnightly from March through to October, then drop to monthly over winter. Weekly visits suit lawns that need a consistently sharp look, while one-off cuts are ideal before events, viewings, or when the grass has simply got away from you. I will recommend the right schedule based on your lawn size and how fast it grows.

cards.title: Weekly maintenance
cards.description: Best for lawns that need to look sharp at all times, such as front gardens or properties where presentation matters. Weekly mowing keeps growth even and prevents the lawn from ever looking unkempt. Particularly useful during the fast-growing months from April to September.

cards.title: Fortnightly maintenance
cards.description: The most popular option across my customers in Cornwall. Fortnightly visits keep the lawn tidy without overdoing it, and the cost stays manageable. I will adjust the schedule seasonally, moving to monthly visits over winter when growth slows down.

cards.title: One-off tidy & reset
cards.description: Ideal before guests, photos, property viewings, or when the lawn has been left a bit too long between cuts. I will bring it back to a clean height, tidy the edges, and leave it looking presentable. No ongoing commitment needed.

cards.title: Seasonal refresh
cards.description: A thorough tidy at the start of spring or autumn to set the lawn up for the season ahead. This often includes a lower cut to remove winter growth, edging, and practical advice on feeding or treating any bare patches that have appeared.

results.label: Recent results

valueBand.label: Value
valueBand.title: A lawn that looks good week after week
valueBand.description: Consistency is what makes lawn care feel effortless. I turn up on the same day each cycle, cut to the right height for the time of year, and leave clean edges every time. If rain shifts the schedule, I will let you know and rebook promptly. You should not have to chase your gardener or wonder when the next visit is.

bullets.title: Consistent visits
bullets.description: I keep to a reliable schedule so your lawn never gets ahead of you. Same day, same quality, every visit. If I need to shift a day due to weather, I will message you in advance.

bullets.title: Clean edges
bullets.description: Crisp borders and clean strimming around every edge, included as standard. This is what separates a quick mow from a properly finished lawn.

bullets.title: Weather-aware
bullets.description: Cornwall's weather can be unpredictable, especially near the coast. If heavy rain makes cutting impractical, I will let you know and rebook to the next dry window, usually within a day or two.

faq.label: FAQs
faq.title: Quick answers
faq.description: If you don't see your question here, just get in touch.

items.question: Do you offer weekly or fortnightly visits?
items.answer: Yes, both are available. Most customers in Cornwall go fortnightly from March to October, then drop to monthly over winter. Because of Cornwall's mild coastal climate, lawns here grow almost year-round unlike the rest of the UK, so they still benefit from a winter cut now and then.

items.question: How much does lawn mowing cost in Cornwall?
items.answer: A small front lawn typically costs £20 to £30 per cut. An average-sized garden is around £30 to £50. That includes mowing, edging, strimming, and a clean blow-down. I'll confirm your exact price after seeing a photo or two of the lawn.

items.question: Do you edge and strim?
items.answer: Yes, always. Edging and strimming are included in every lawn cut as standard. Clean edges are the difference between a lawn that looks mowed and one that looks properly finished.

items.question: Can you take away grass clippings?
items.answer: Yes, clippings can be collected and removed. Green waste removal is £10 per dumpy bag. Just let me know your preference when requesting a quote and I'll include it in the price.

items.question: What happens if it rains?
items.answer: If heavy rain makes cutting impractical, I'll let you know and reschedule to the next dry window, usually within a day or two. Light drizzle is fine, this is Cornwall after all.

items.question: Do you cover my area?
items.answer: I'm based near Newquay and cover most of Cornwall including Truro, St Austell, Bodmin, Padstow, Perranporth, and St Ives. Send your postcode and I'll confirm availability, usually the same day.

finalCta.title: Ready for a lawn that stays tidy without the hassle?
finalCta.description: Send me a couple of photos of your lawn and I will recommend a schedule and quote it clearly. Most quotes are confirmed within 24 hours, and there is no obligation.
